description: This header file declares classes related to the expansion and layout computation for strided slice operations within the TensorFlow DTensor MLIR framework, specifically for SPMD (Single Program Multiple Data) expansion.
external_methods: StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutForward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& input_layouts)
StatusOr<llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>> ComputeLayoutBackward(mlir::Operation* op, const llvm::DenseMap<int, Layout>& output_layouts)

classes.name: StridedSliceSPMDExpander
classes.description: Handles the expansion and layout computations for the strided slice operation in SPMD mode.

classes.name: TensorStridedSliceUpdateSPMDExpander
classes.description: Manages the expansion and layout calculations for tensor strided slice updates within SPMD.

classes.name: StridedSliceGradSPMDExpander
classes.description: Responsible for expansion and layout logic for the gradient of the strided slice operation in SPMD.

methods.name: ExpandOp
methods.description: Expands the given MLIR operation for SPMD execution.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutForward
methods.description: Computes the layout of the operation's inputs in the forward pass.

methods.name: ComputeLayoutBackward
methods.description: Computes the layout of the operation's outputs in the backward pass.
